added_models.model: NOD/SCID/Fabry (NSF) mice xenotransplanted with lentivirus (LV/AGA)-transduced human CD34+ cells

engagement.model: NOD/SCID/Fabry (NSF) mice xenotransplanted with lentivirus (LV/AGA)-transduced human CD34+ cells
engagement.note: NSF mice given human CD34+ cells carrying an alpha-Gal A lentivector raised plasma alpha-Gal A activity; no patient data yet.
engagement.quote: While both experimental groups showed similar engraftment levels, only the therapeutic group displayed a significant increase in plasma α-gal A activity.
engagement.judgement: Opening entry at the NSF line's first use; vector was a sibling construct (LV-alpha-gal A/IRES/hCD25), so product_in_model false.

engagement.model: NOD/SCID/Fabry (NSF) mice xenotransplanted with lentivirus (LV/AGA)-transduced human CD34+ cells
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level. NCT02800070 has no results posted (registry checked). Paired by us: Huang 2017 is the model side (LV/AGA-transduced patient CD34+ cells in NSF mice).
engagement.note: In FACTs (NCT02800070, LV/AGA, the vector later licensed as AVR-RD-01) all five men reached near-normal alpha-Gal A within a week, as the NSF xenograft predicted.
engagement.short: Patients made alpha-Gal A, as predicted
engagement.quote: All patients produced α-gal A to near normal levels within one week.
engagement.reason: Enzyme activity rose in all patients
engagement.judgement: Paired comparison; model and trial used the same LV/AGA construct, which is the voxeralgagene autotemcel lineage. Direction only, as mouse and human assays differ.

efficacy.model: NOD/SCID/Fabry (NSF) mice xenotransplanted with lentivirus (LV/AGA)-transduced human CD34+ cells
efficacy.note: NSF xenograft predicted Gb3 clearance in kidney and heart; no patient trial yet.
efficacy.short: Xenograft cleared kidney and heart Gb3
efficacy.quote: Importantly, only in the therapeutically-transduced cohort was a significant Gb(3) reduction found in the heart and kidney, key target organs for the amelioration of Fabry disease in humans.

efficacy.model: NOD/SCID/Fabry (NSF) mice xenotransplanted with lentivirus (LV/AGA)-transduced human CD34+ cells
efficacy.confidence_note: Registry results record: outcome typed PRIMARY in results; mean change -3.555 (range -4.020 to -3.090), only 2 analysed; trial terminated when AVROBIO dropped Fabry. Model side Huang 2017 abstract.

patient_trials.quote: reductions in plasma and urine globotriaosylceramide (Gb3) and globotriaosylsphingosine (lyso-Gb3) are seen.

efficacy.note: FAB-201 (AVR-RD-01): kidney PTC Gb3 inclusions fell by 3.6 per capillary at week 48 (n=2, registered primary), matching the xenograft's kidney Gb3 clearance.
efficacy.short: Kidney Gb3 inclusions fell, as predicted
efficacy.quote: Healthy renal tissue would have no Gb3 inclusions. A reduction from baseline is desirable.
efficacy.reason: Kidney Gb3 fell in two patients
efficacy.judgement: The results record lists kidney PTC Gb3 change as a primary outcome alongside AEs, so endpoint_role primary; n=2 keeps confidence medium.

safety.model: NOD/SCID/Fabry (NSF) mice xenotransplanted with lentivirus (LV/AGA)-transduced human CD34+ cells
safety.note: GLP-style toxicology in NSF mice xenotransplanted with the LV/AGA cell product found minimal untoward effects; supported the Health Canada CTA.
safety.quote: Additional toxicology studies employing NSF mice xenotransplanted with the therapeutic cell product demonstrated minimal untoward effects.
safety.judgement: Opening safety entry at the first public statement of the tox study; FACTs had started in 2016 but reported no safety data until 2021.

safety.model: NOD/SCID/Fabry (NSF) mice xenotransplanted with lentivirus (LV/AGA)-transduced human CD34+ cells
safety.confidence_note: Abstract-level. Confirmed later by NCT03454893 results (2024-01-05): no SAEs considered related to AVR-RD-01, no aberrant clonal expansion, no RCL.
safety.note: No serious adverse events attributable to the LV/AGA cell product in five patients; conditioning-related events only, as xenograft toxicology predicted.
safety.quote: No serious adverse events (AEs) are attributable to the investigational product.
safety.judgement: Paired comparison; xenograft silence on insertional or product toxicity held over follow-up so far. Conditioning (melphalan/busulfan) harms are outside the model.
